basics.name: Allen Ng
basics.label: Lead Platform Engineer | Enterprise Deployment, Security/SSO & Hands-on Delivery
basics.summary: Hands-on engineering lead with 9+ years shipping production software and infrastructure in regulated enterprises and startups. At MetLife Japan, partners with the CTO and internal teams to turn operational problems into platforms: self-service infrastructure (React, Go), SSO as code across 1,000+ applications, and automated VM patching. Works with technical and business stakeholders in English, Japanese, Mandarin, and Cantonese.

work.summary: Global insurer; enterprise infrastructure in a regulated financial-services environment.
highlights: Partnered with the CTO to design and build an end-to-end self-service infrastructure platform (React, Go, Azure ML), enabling internal users to self-manage infrastructure across multiple components.
Developed an internal Terraform provider for Ping Identity PingAccess, bringing complex SSO configurations for 1,000+ enterprise applications under Infrastructure-as-Code.
Designed and built a 0→1 VM patching platform covering the full lifecycle of backup, patch deployment, and automated rollback on failure, reducing the headcount required for BAU operations.
Served as internal AI consultant for infrastructure teams, running hands-on workshops that apply AI tools to real day-to-day engineering tasks.

Led the adoption of Ansible across MetLife Japan in alignment with MetLife Global strategy, standardizing infrastructure automation and replacing manual legacy workflows with measurable cost reduction.
Established enterprise-wide Infrastructure-as-Code practices for the APIM catalog, reverse proxies, and related platform components, enforcing full IaC and standardized change workflows.
Introduced Chef as the organization-wide configuration management standard across ~2,500 VMs and physical servers.
Built fully automated, self-service VM provisioning: image templates with Packer, resource provisioning with Terraform, and configuration management with Chef.
Migrated legacy monitoring, reporting, and deployment practices to modern standards (Terraform, Splunk, Chef), eliminating manual operations.
Partnered with the CTO to translate business requirements into engineering strategy and deliverable goals.
Led a team of 10 engineers across Japanese- and English-speaking members, owning technical execution and cross-functional collaboration.
Owned high-level system architecture and technical roadmaps for the microservices platform.
Designed and implemented Go microservices, including Protobuf schema design and gRPC service implementation.
Owned platform infrastructure and delivery on Kubernetes, Pulumi, CircleCI, and ArgoCD.
Established test automation spanning unit tests, cross-service E2E tests, and headless-browser tests simulating user behavior.
Conducted technical interviews for Go and SRE roles, screening 50+ candidates.
Joined as an initial member of a new product team; built a complete Go microservice from scratch.
Owned day-to-day infrastructure while improving CI/CD, monitoring, ML pipelines, and development workflows.

work.summary: Crowdsourced delivery platform startup operating in HK, SG, MY, and VN.
highlights: Led the operations product team, owning performance optimization, workflow improvements, and delivery-matching algorithms; delivered full-stack features from business requirements.
Designed and built data solutions on AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, Firehose, PySpark).
Led development of a React Native mobile application.
Developed custom geocoding algorithms (address segmentation and tagging) for multilingual addresses.
Trained deep learning models for image classification.
Maintained company-wide systems and introduced a Kubernetes cluster to improve DevOps practices.
Refactored legacy PHP web applications to Node.js.
Deployed Magento e-commerce and built an integrated internal product-management backend.
